conclusion: Reproduces on unchanged v39 and v40, with D3D11 and FFmpeg video decoders, in video-only headless harness. Not specific to v40 rig, recording, or hardware video decode. Periodic presentation scheduling/host environment remains suspected; exact OS/compositor cause unproven. Runtime render throughput was not benchmarked and is not accepted from these results.
process_inventory: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process failed: access to CIM resource unavailable. Get-Process for node/python/chrome returned no inventory. No bypass or process termination attempted. Harness launched no runtime/server/recording, and closed its own browser in finally.
settings: Only temporary flag on dedicated child browser; no persisted settings, installs, security changes, user-process termination, uploads, or source changes.
interpretation_limit: Hardware decoder processing median2.1/3.4ms,p95 12.8ms and v40 RAF max14.5ms do not show a sustained JS/decode bottleneck. Software processing median38ms,p9541ms can itself exceed the33.3ms frame budget, so similar drop counts do not prove an identical cause. Periodic presentation/host scheduling is a hypothesis, not a confirmed diagnosis.
